data.name: v_calendar_events
data.sql: CREATE VIEW v_calendar_events AS SELECT t.date_key AS date_key, 'transaction' AS event_type, 'transaction' AS ref_type, t.id AS ref_id, COALESCE(p.name, t.note, t.subtype) AS title, t.original_amount_minor AS amount_minor, t.original_currency_code AS currency_code, 'info' AS severity FROM transactions AS t LEFT JOIN payees AS p ON p.id = t.payee_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT o.due_date_key, 'recurringDue', 'recurringOccurrence', o.id, rt.name, COALESCE(o.paid_amount_minor, rt.default_amount_minor), rt.currency_code, 'warning' FROM recurring_occurrences AS o JOIN recurring_templates AS rt ON rt.id = o.template_id WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status = 'due' AND rt.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT b.expiry_date_key, 'batchExpiry', 'inventoryBatch', b.id, i.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM inventory_batches AS b JOIN items AS i ON i.id = b.item_id WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.expiry_date_key IS NOT NULL AND b.remaining_quantity_milli > 0 AND i.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT a.warranty_end_date_key, 'warrantyEnd', 'asset', a.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM assets AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.warranty_end_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.status <> 'disposed' UNION ALL SELECT a.next_service_due_date_key, 'serviceDue', 'asset', a.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM assets AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.next_service_due_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.status <> 'disposed' UNION ALL SELECT sr.next_due_date_key, 'serviceDue', 'serviceRecord', sr.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM service_records AS sr JOIN assets AS a ON a.id = sr.asset_id WHERE sr.deleted_at IS NULL AND sr.next_due_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT sl.target_date_key, 'shoppingTarget', 'shoppingList', sl.id, sl.name, NULL, NULL, 'info' FROM shopping_lists AS sl WHERE sl.deleted_at IS NULL AND sl.target_date_key IS NOT NULL AND sl.is_archived = 0

data.name: v_recurring_due
data.sql: CREATE VIEW v_recurring_due AS SELECT t.id AS template_id, t.name, t.kind, t.direction, t.default_amount_minor, t.currency_code, t.next_due_date_key, t.interval_unit, t.interval_count, t.payee_id, t.default_account_id, t.default_payment_method_id, t.tag_id, t.auto_remind, t.remind_days_before, o.id AS occurrence_id, o.due_date_key AS occurrence_due_date_key, o.status FROM recurring_templates AS t LEFT JOIN recurring_occurrences AS o ON o.template_id = t.id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status = 'due' WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.is_paused = 0

data.name: v_asset_alerts
data.sql: CREATE VIEW v_asset_alerts AS SELECT a.id AS asset_id, a.name, a.type, a.status, a.warranty_end_date_key, a.next_service_due_date_key, a.service_interval_days, a.primary_contact_name, a.primary_contact_phone FROM assets AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status <> 'disposed' AND(a.warranty_end_date_key IS NOT NULL OR a.next_service_due_date_key IS NOT NULL)

data.name: v_item_stock
data.sql: CREATE VIEW v_item_stock AS SELECT i.id AS item_id, i.unit_category, i.low_stock_threshold_milli, COALESCE(SUM(b.remaining_quantity_milli), 0) AS total_remaining_milli, COUNT(b.id) AS batch_count, MIN(b.expiry_date_key) AS nearest_expiry_date_key, CASE WHEN i.low_stock_threshold_milli IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(SUM(b.remaining_quantity_milli), 0) < i.low_stock_threshold_milli THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_low_stock FROM items AS i LEFT JOIN inventory_batches AS b ON b.item_id = i.id AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.remaining_quantity_milli > 0 WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY i.id

data.name: v_batch_stock_check
data.sql: CREATE VIEW v_batch_stock_check AS SELECT b.id AS batch_id, b.item_id, b.remaining_quantity_milli AS cached_remaining_milli, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind IN ('openingIn', 'purchaseIn', 'manualIn', 'adjustIn') THEN m.quantity_milli ELSE -m.quantity_milli END) FROM stock_movements AS m WHERE m.batch_id = b.id), 0) AS ledger_remaining_milli, b.remaining_quantity_milli - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind IN ('openingIn', 'purchaseIn', 'manualIn', 'adjustIn') THEN m.quantity_milli ELSE -m.quantity_milli END) FROM stock_movements AS m WHERE m.batch_id = b.id), 0) AS discrepancy_milli FROM inventory_batches AS b WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL

data.name: v_low_stock
data.sql: CREATE VIEW v_low_stock AS SELECT s.item_id, s.unit_category, s.total_remaining_milli, s.low_stock_threshold_milli, s.low_stock_threshold_milli - s.total_remaining_milli AS shortfall_milli, s.nearest_expiry_date_key FROM v_item_stock AS s WHERE s.is_low_stock = 1

data.name: v_active_transactions
data.sql: CREATE VIEW v_active_transactions AS SELECT t.id AS tx_id, t.kind, t.subtype, t.occurred_at, t.date_key, t.month_key, t.original_amount_minor, t.original_currency_code, t.from_account_id, fa.name AS from_account_name, t.to_account_id, ta.name AS to_account_name, t.payment_method_id, pm.name AS payment_method_name, t.payee_id, p.name AS payee_name, t.note, t.needs_review, t.recurring_template_id, t.recurring_occurrence_id, t.converted_amount_minor, t.converted_currency_code, t.conversion_rate, t.conversion_rate_raw, t.conversion_date_key, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM transactions AS t LEFT JOIN accounts AS fa ON fa.id = t.from_account_id LEFT JOIN accounts AS ta ON ta.id = t.to_account_id LEFT JOIN payment_methods AS pm ON pm.id = t.payment_method_id LEFT JOIN payees AS p ON p.id = t.payee_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL

data.name: v_transaction_allocation
data.sql: CREATE VIEW v_transaction_allocation AS SELECT t.id AS tx_id, t.original_amount_minor AS amount_minor, t.original_currency_code AS currency_code, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.line_amount_minor) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS allocated_minor, t.original_amount_minor - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.line_amount_minor) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS unallocated_minor, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL) AS line_count FROM transactions AS t WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL

data.name: v_monthly_totals
data.sql: CREATE VIEW v_monthly_totals AS SELECT month_key, kind, original_currency_code AS currency_code, SUM(original_amount_minor) AS sum_minor, COUNT(*) AS tx_count FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY month_key, kind, original_currency_code

data.name: v_account_ledger
data.sql: CREATE VIEW v_account_ledger AS SELECT id AS tx_id, to_account_id AS account_id, original_amount_minor AS signed_minor, original_currency_code AS currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind IN ('deposit', 'adjustmentIncrease') UNION ALL SELECT id, from_account_id, -original_amount_minor, original_currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind IN ('withdrawal', 'adjustmentDecrease') UNION ALL SELECT id, from_account_id, -original_amount_minor, original_currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind = 'transfer' UNION ALL SELECT id, to_account_id, original_amount_minor, original_currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind = 'transfer'

data.name: v_account_balances
data.sql: CREATE VIEW v_account_balances AS SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.currency_code AS currency_code, a.opening_balance_minor + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.signed_minor) FROM v_account_ledger AS l WHERE l.account_id = a.id), 0) AS balance_minor FROM accounts AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL

sql.sql: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "items_fts" USING fts5(name, notes, content = items, content_rowid = rowid);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "units" ("code" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "factor_to_base_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "display_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "items" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "unit_category" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_display_unit_code" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES units (code), "item_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "low_stock_threshold_milli" INTEGER NULL, "expiry_notify_days" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "is_favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_favorite" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TRIGGER items_fts_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON items BEGIN INSERT INTO items_fts ("rowid", name, notes) VALUES (new."rowid", new.name, new.notes);END
CREATE TRIGGER items_fts_after_delete AFTER DELETE ON items BEGIN INSERT INTO items_fts (items_fts, "rowid", name, notes) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.name, old.notes);END

CREATE TRIGGER items_fts_after_update AFTER UPDATE ON items BEGIN INSERT INTO items_fts (items_fts, "rowid", name, notes) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.name, old.notes);INSERT INTO items_fts ("rowid", name, notes) VALUES (new."rowid", new.name, new.notes);END
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions_fts" USING fts5(note, content = transactions, content_rowid = rowid);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "currencies" ("code" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "decimal_digits" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_enabled" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("code"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "accounts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), "opening_balance_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "opening_balance_date_key" INTEGER NOT NULL, "color_argb" INTEGER NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NULL, "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "include_in_net_worth" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("include_in_net_worth" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payment_methods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "payees" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "phone" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color_argb" INTEGER NULL, "icon_key" TEXT NULL, "parent_tag_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), "allowed_in_deposit" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("allowed_in_deposit" IN (0, 1)), "allowed_in_withdrawal" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("allowed_in_withdrawal" IN (0, 1)), "allowed_in_inventory" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("allowed_in_inventory" IN (0, 1)), "allowed_in_shopping" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("allowed_in_shopping" IN (0, 1)), "allowed_in_recurring" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("allowed_in_recurring" IN (0, 1)), "allowed_in_service" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("allowed_in_service" IN (0, 1)), "is_system" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_system" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_occurrences" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES recurring_templates (id), "due_date_key" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "paid_transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "paid_amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "paid_date_key" INTEGER NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "inventory_batches" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "initial_quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "remaining_quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_code_at_purchase" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES units (code), "expiry_date_key" INTEGER NULL, "purchased_date_key" INTEGER NOT NULL, "unit_cost_minor" INTEGER NULL, "cost_currency_code" TEXT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), "source_transaction_line_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transaction_lines (id), "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "storage_location" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_lines" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "line_no" INTEGER NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL, "item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "quantity_milli" INTEGER NULL, "unit_code" TEXT NULL REFERENCES units (code), "unit_price_minor" INTEGER NULL, "line_amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "destination" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_batch_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES inventory_batches (id), "created_asset_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES assets (id), "created_recurring_template_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_templates (id), "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "assets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "brand" TEXT NULL, "model_no" TEXT NULL, "serial_no" TEXT NULL, "purchase_date_key" INTEGER NULL, "purchase_price_minor" INTEGER NULL, "purchase_currency_code" TEXT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), "source_transaction_line_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transaction_lines (id), "warranty_start_date_key" INTEGER NULL, "warranty_end_date_key" INTEGER NULL, "warranty_provider" TEXT NULL, "warranty_note" TEXT NULL, "service_interval_days" INTEGER NULL, "next_service_due_date_key" INTEGER NULL, "primary_contact_name" TEXT NULL, "primary_contact_phone" TEXT NULL, "location" TEXT NULL, "linked_recurring_template_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_templates (id), "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "disposed_at_date_key" INTEGER NULL, "disposal_reason" TEXT NULL, "disposal_note" TEXT NULL, "disposal_amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurring_templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "normalized_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "direction" TEXT NOT NULL, "default_amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), "payee_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payees (id), "default_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "default_payment_method_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payment_methods (id), "tag_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), "interval_unit" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "anchor_day_of_month" INTEGER NULL, "anchor_month" INTEGER NULL, "anchor_weekday" INTEGER NULL, "start_date_key" INTEGER NOT NULL, "end_date_key" INTEGER NULL, "next_due_date_key" INTEGER NOT NULL, "is_paused" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_paused" IN (0, 1)), "auto_remind" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("auto_remind" IN (0, 1)), "remind_days_before" INTEGER NOT NULL, "linked_asset_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES assets (id), "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "subtype" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date_key" INTEGER NOT NULL, "month_key" INTEGER NOT NULL, "original_amount_minor" INTEGER NOT NULL, "original_currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), "from_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "to_account_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES accounts (id), "payment_method_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payment_methods (id), "payee_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES payees (id), "note" TEXT NULL, "needs_review" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("needs_review" IN (0, 1)), "recurring_template_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_templates (id), "recurring_occurrence_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES recurring_occurrences (id), "converted_amount_minor" INTEGER NULL, "converted_currency_code" TEXT NULL, "conversion_rate" REAL NULL, "conversion_rate_raw" TEXT NULL, "conversion_date_key" INTEGER NULL, "delete_reason" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (original_amount_minor > 0), CHECK ((kind IN ('deposit','adjustmentIncrease') AND to_account_id IS NOT NULL AND from_account_id IS NULL) OR (kind IN ('withdrawal','adjustmentDecrease') AND from_account_id IS NOT NULL AND to_account_id IS NULL) OR (kind = 'transfer' AND from_account_id IS NOT NULL AND to_account_id IS NOT NULL AND from_account_id <> to_account_id)), CHECK (date_key / 100 = month_key));
CREATE TRIGGER transactions_fts_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON transactions BEGIN INSERT INTO transactions_fts ("rowid", note) VALUES (new."rowid", new.note);END
CREATE TRIGGER transactions_fts_after_delete AFTER DELETE ON transactions BEGIN INSERT INTO transactions_fts (transactions_fts, "rowid", note) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.note);END

CREATE TRIGGER transactions_fts_after_update AFTER UPDATE ON transactions BEGIN INSERT INTO transactions_fts (transactions_fts, "rowid", note) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.note);INSERT INTO transactions_fts ("rowid", note) VALUES (new."rowid", new.note);END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "service_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets (id), "service_date_key" INTEGER NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider_name" TEXT NULL, "provider_phone" TEXT NULL, "cost_minor" INTEGER NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), "linked_transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "next_due_date_key" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_tags" ("transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("transaction_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "item_tags" ("item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("item_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "asset_tags" ("asset_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES assets (id), "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("asset_id", "tag_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "currency_rates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "base_code" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), "quote_code" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES currencies (code), "rate_date_key" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rate" REAL NOT NULL, "rate_raw" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "owner_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "relative_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "stock_movements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "batch_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_batches (id), "item_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "quantity_milli" INTEGER NOT NULL, "occurred_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date_key" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "linked_transaction_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transactions (id), "reverses_movement_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES stock_movements (id), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (quantity_milli > 0));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_items_identity ON items (normalized_name, unit_category) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_accounts_name ON accounts (normalized_name) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_tags_name ON tags (normalized_name) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_payees_name ON payees (normalized_name) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_lists" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_default" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_default" IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), "target_date_key" INTEGER NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "shopping_entries" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "list_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES shopping_lists (id), "item_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES items (id), "free_text" TEXT NULL, "quantity_milli" INTEGER NULL, "unit_code" TEXT NULL REFERENCES units (code), "tag_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES tags (id), "estimated_price_minor" INTEGER NULL, "is_checked" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_checked" IN (0, 1)), "checked_at" INTEGER NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, "auto_state" TEXT NOT NULL, "snooze_until_date_key" INTEGER NULL, "generated_at_stock_milli" INTEGER NULL, "purchased_transaction_line_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES transaction_lines (id), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE VIEW v_calendar_events AS SELECT t.date_key AS date_key, 'transaction' AS event_type, 'transaction' AS ref_type, t.id AS ref_id, COALESCE(p.name, t.note, t.subtype) AS title, t.original_amount_minor AS amount_minor, t.original_currency_code AS currency_code, 'info' AS severity FROM transactions AS t LEFT JOIN payees AS p ON p.id = t.payee_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT o.due_date_key, 'recurringDue', 'recurringOccurrence', o.id, rt.name, COALESCE(o.paid_amount_minor, rt.default_amount_minor), rt.currency_code, 'warning' FROM recurring_occurrences AS o JOIN recurring_templates AS rt ON rt.id = o.template_id WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status = 'due' AND rt.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT b.expiry_date_key, 'batchExpiry', 'inventoryBatch', b.id, i.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM inventory_batches AS b JOIN items AS i ON i.id = b.item_id WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.expiry_date_key IS NOT NULL AND b.remaining_quantity_milli > 0 AND i.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT a.warranty_end_date_key, 'warrantyEnd', 'asset', a.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM assets AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.warranty_end_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.status <> 'disposed' UNION ALL SELECT a.next_service_due_date_key, 'serviceDue', 'asset', a.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM assets AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.next_service_due_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.status <> 'disposed' UNION ALL SELECT sr.next_due_date_key, 'serviceDue', 'serviceRecord', sr.id, a.name, NULL, NULL, 'warning' FROM service_records AS sr JOIN assets AS a ON a.id = sr.asset_id WHERE sr.deleted_at IS NULL AND sr.next_due_date_key IS NOT NULL AND a.deleted_at IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT sl.target_date_key, 'shoppingTarget', 'shoppingList', sl.id, sl.name, NULL, NULL, 'info' FROM shopping_lists AS sl WHERE sl.deleted_at IS NULL AND sl.target_date_key IS NOT NULL AND sl.is_archived = 0

CREATE VIEW v_recurring_due AS SELECT t.id AS template_id, t.name, t.kind, t.direction, t.default_amount_minor, t.currency_code, t.next_due_date_key, t.interval_unit, t.interval_count, t.payee_id, t.default_account_id, t.default_payment_method_id, t.tag_id, t.auto_remind, t.remind_days_before, o.id AS occurrence_id, o.due_date_key AS occurrence_due_date_key, o.status FROM recurring_templates AS t LEFT JOIN recurring_occurrences AS o ON o.template_id = t.id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.status = 'due' WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.is_paused = 0

CREATE VIEW v_asset_alerts AS SELECT a.id AS asset_id, a.name, a.type, a.status, a.warranty_end_date_key, a.next_service_due_date_key, a.service_interval_days, a.primary_contact_name, a.primary_contact_phone FROM assets AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.status <> 'disposed' AND(a.warranty_end_date_key IS NOT NULL OR a.next_service_due_date_key IS NOT NULL)

CREATE VIEW v_item_stock AS SELECT i.id AS item_id, i.unit_category, i.low_stock_threshold_milli, COALESCE(SUM(b.remaining_quantity_milli), 0) AS total_remaining_milli, COUNT(b.id) AS batch_count, MIN(b.expiry_date_key) AS nearest_expiry_date_key, CASE WHEN i.low_stock_threshold_milli IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(SUM(b.remaining_quantity_milli), 0) < i.low_stock_threshold_milli THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_low_stock FROM items AS i LEFT JOIN inventory_batches AS b ON b.item_id = i.id AND b.deleted_at IS NULL AND b.remaining_quantity_milli > 0 WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY i.id

CREATE VIEW v_batch_stock_check AS SELECT b.id AS batch_id, b.item_id, b.remaining_quantity_milli AS cached_remaining_milli, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind IN ('openingIn', 'purchaseIn', 'manualIn', 'adjustIn') THEN m.quantity_milli ELSE -m.quantity_milli END) FROM stock_movements AS m WHERE m.batch_id = b.id), 0) AS ledger_remaining_milli, b.remaining_quantity_milli - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN m.kind IN ('openingIn', 'purchaseIn', 'manualIn', 'adjustIn') THEN m.quantity_milli ELSE -m.quantity_milli END) FROM stock_movements AS m WHERE m.batch_id = b.id), 0) AS discrepancy_milli FROM inventory_batches AS b WHERE b.deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE VIEW v_low_stock AS SELECT s.item_id, s.unit_category, s.total_remaining_milli, s.low_stock_threshold_milli, s.low_stock_threshold_milli - s.total_remaining_milli AS shortfall_milli, s.nearest_expiry_date_key FROM v_item_stock AS s WHERE s.is_low_stock = 1

CREATE VIEW v_active_transactions AS SELECT t.id AS tx_id, t.kind, t.subtype, t.occurred_at, t.date_key, t.month_key, t.original_amount_minor, t.original_currency_code, t.from_account_id, fa.name AS from_account_name, t.to_account_id, ta.name AS to_account_name, t.payment_method_id, pm.name AS payment_method_name, t.payee_id, p.name AS payee_name, t.note, t.needs_review, t.recurring_template_id, t.recurring_occurrence_id, t.converted_amount_minor, t.converted_currency_code, t.conversion_rate, t.conversion_rate_raw, t.conversion_date_key, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM transactions AS t LEFT JOIN accounts AS fa ON fa.id = t.from_account_id LEFT JOIN accounts AS ta ON ta.id = t.to_account_id LEFT JOIN payment_methods AS pm ON pm.id = t.payment_method_id LEFT JOIN payees AS p ON p.id = t.payee_id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE VIEW v_transaction_allocation AS SELECT t.id AS tx_id, t.original_amount_minor AS amount_minor, t.original_currency_code AS currency_code, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.line_amount_minor) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS allocated_minor, t.original_amount_minor - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.line_amount_minor) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL), 0) AS unallocated_minor, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM transaction_lines AS l WHERE l.transaction_id = t.id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL) AS line_count FROM transactions AS t WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE VIEW v_monthly_totals AS SELECT month_key, kind, original_currency_code AS currency_code, SUM(original_amount_minor) AS sum_minor, COUNT(*) AS tx_count FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY month_key, kind, original_currency_code

CREATE VIEW v_account_ledger AS SELECT id AS tx_id, to_account_id AS account_id, original_amount_minor AS signed_minor, original_currency_code AS currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind IN ('deposit', 'adjustmentIncrease') UNION ALL SELECT id, from_account_id, -original_amount_minor, original_currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind IN ('withdrawal', 'adjustmentDecrease') UNION ALL SELECT id, from_account_id, -original_amount_minor, original_currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind = 'transfer' UNION ALL SELECT id, to_account_id, original_amount_minor, original_currency_code, date_key, kind FROM transactions WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND kind = 'transfer'

CREATE VIEW v_account_balances AS SELECT a.id AS account_id, a.currency_code AS currency_code, a.opening_balance_minor + COALESCE((SELECT SUM(l.signed_minor) FROM v_account_ledger AS l WHERE l.account_id = a.id), 0) AS balance_minor FROM accounts AS a WHERE a.deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notification_schedule" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "ref_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "scheduled_at_utc_millis" INTEGER NOT NULL, "android_notification_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "backup_history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "file_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "app_version" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "record_counts_json" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "analytics_cache" ("cache_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "params_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "payload_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "computed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stale_after" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("cache_key"));
